ingameEffects.description: ... Upon activating this skill, gains the Tempered effect, increasing the DMG dealt by subsequent Basic Attack: Converging Spear attacks by 20% for 50s. ...
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Sigrid's DMG from Basic Attack: Converging Spear is increased by 20% for 50s.

ingameEffects.label: Sky Knight (Core Passive)
ingameEffects.description: ... Activating or refreshing Aerial Patrol Spear increases Sigrid's CRIT Rate by 66% for 8s. Repeated triggers extend the duration by 8s, up to a maximum of 40s. ...
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Sigrid's CRIT Rate is increased by 66% for 8s, up to a maximum duration of 40s.

ingameEffects.label: Legion of the Skies (Additional Ability)
ingameEffects.description:
When another character in your squad is a Support or Stun character:

Sigrid's ATK increases by 120. This effect scales with character level, with each level providing an additional increase of 12, up to a maximum increase of 840. DMG increases by 15% when hitting enemies in the Contamination state.

ingameEffects.label: Legion of the Skies (Additional Ability)
ingameEffects.description:
When another character in your squad is a Support or Stun character:

Sigrid's ATK increases by 120. This effect scales with character level, with each level providing an additional increase of 12, up to a maximum increase of 840. DMG increases by 15% when hitting enemies in the Contamination state.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Sigrid's DMG is increased by 15% against enemies in the Contamination state.

ingameEffects.label: Long, Long Ago (Mindscape Cinema N°1)
ingameEffects.description: Upon activating the 3rd stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear, enters the Aerial Patrol Spear and gains 1 additional activation of Basic Attack: Converging Spear. When activations exceed the stored Basic Attack: Converging Spear's activation limit, the next Basic Attack: Converging Spear's final hit deals an additional 100% of ATK as Ice DMG. Sigrid's ATK increases by 25%.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Sigrid's ATK is increased by 25%. Basic Attack: Converging Spear's additional DMG is available in the Damage Calculator.

ingameEffects.label: Legend's First Act (Mindscape Cinema N°2)
ingameEffects.description: PEN Ratio of Unbridled Spear attacks and Basic Attack: Converging Spear increases by 24%. The duration of Aerial Patrol Spear is extended by 2s. Sigrid's Decibel Generation Rate increases by 10%.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Sigrid's PEN Ratio from Unbridled Spear attacks and Basic Attack: Converging Spear is increased by 24%.

ingameEffects.label: Hero in Training (Mindscape Cinema N°4)
ingameEffects.description: Each time upon gaining Aerial Patrol Spear, DMG dealt increases by 18% for 8s. Repeated triggers extend the duration by 8s, up to a maximum of 40s.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Sigrid's DMG is increased by 18% for 8s, up to a maximum duration of 40s.

ingameEffects.label: Knight of the Skies (Mindscape Cinema N°6)
ingameEffects.description: When Basic Attack: Converging Spear's 1st/2nd/3rd stage's final hit lands, it deals an additional 80%/90%/100% ATK as Ice DMG. There is no more limit on the number of times Sigrid can enter the Formation Breaker state upon hitting a Stunned enemy with Chain Attack: Encroaching Ice. Formation Breaker state's Basic Attack: Converging Spear will activate faster.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: This ability is available in Sigrid's Damage Calculator.

basicAttacks.name: Frost-Tipped Spear (Basic Attack)
basicAttacks.description:
Press [BASIC] to activate:

Launches up to four forward slashes, dealing Ice DMG. The 4th hit of /bBasic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear//b is considered an /bUnbridled Spear//b attack.

basicAttacks.name: Converging Spear (Basic Attack)
basicAttacks.description:
While in the /bAerial Patrol Spear//b state and /bBasic Attack: Converging Spear//b can be used, hold [BASIC] to activate:

Launches the corresponding /bBasic Attack: Converging Spear//b based on the current stage, dealing Ice DMG. /bBasic Attack: Converging Spear//b has three stages. Each use advances it to the next stage.

After performing the third stage of /bBasic Attack: Converging Spear//b, it resets to the first stage. If Sigrid is attacked while charging the 1st or 2nd stage of /bBasic Attack: Converging Spear//b, she blocks with her shield. On a successful block, the attack's DMG is negated, the next /bBasic Attack: Converging Spear//b deals 100% more Daze, the state is refreshed, and she gains one use of /bBasic Attack: Converging Spear//b.

Press [BASIC] after a successful block to perform the corresponding stage of /bBasic Attack: Converging Spear//b. /bBasic Attack: Converging Spear//b performed after /bBasic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear//b retains the current stage of /bBasic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear//b.

DMG taken is reduced by 60% during this skill. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill. Character is invulnerable during the third stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear.

dashAttacks.name: Windchase (Dash Attack)
dashAttacks.description:
Press [BASIC] during a dodge to activate:

Performs a forward cleaving slash, dealing Physical DMG.

dodgeCounters.name: Counterthrust (Dodge Counter)
dodgeCounters.description:
Press [BASIC] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:

Condenses frost around the spearhead before unleashing a powerful counterattack, dealing Ice DMG. When performed after /bBasic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear//b, /bDodge Counter: Counterthrust//b retains the current stage of /bBasic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear//b. This skill is considered an /bUnbridled Spear//b attack. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssists.name: Iron Sentinel (Quick Assist)
quickAssists.description:
When the active character is launched, press [ASSIST] to activate:

Condenses ice before lunging forward, dealing Ice DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: Devouring Frost (Assist Follow-Up)
assistFollowup.description:
Press [BASIC] after a /bDefensive Assist//b to activate:

Swings the spear upward before following with a powerful downward attack, dealing massive Ice DMG. This skill is considered an /bUnbridled Spear//b attack. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

specialAttacks.name: Frostflower (Special Attack)
specialAttacks.description:
Press [SPECIAL] to activate:

Performs three forward thrusts, dealing Ice DMG. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

exSkills.name: Scattered Jade (EX Special Attack)
exSkills.description:
With enough Energy and while not in the /bAerial Patrol Spear//b state, press [EX] to activate:

Performs a series of powerful stabs ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG. This skill is considered an /BUnbridled Spear//b attack. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

exSkills.name: Shattered Jade (EX Special Attack)
exSkills.description:
With enough Energy and while in the /bAerial Patrol State//b state, press [EX] to activate:

Performs a series of powerful lunging stabs ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG. This skill is considered an /bUnbridled Spear//b attack. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chainAttacks.name: Encroaching Ice (Chain Attack)
chainAttacks.description:
When a /bChain Attack//b is triggered, select the character to activate:

Performs a powerful piercing attack against enemies ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG. Upon activating this skill, gains the /bTempered effect//b, increasing the DMG dealt by subsequent /bBasic Attack: Converging Spear//b attacks by 20% for 50s.

When the current skill hits a Stunned elite or boss enemy for the first time, the current stage of /bBasic Attack: Converging Spear//b is recorded and then reset before entering the /bFormation Breaker//b state.

While in /bFormation Breaker//b, /bAerial Patrol Spear//b's duration will not be reduced. Hold [BASIC] to continuously activate the 1st through 3rd stage of /bBasic Attack: Converging Spear//b. After activating the 3rd stage of /bBasic Attack: Converging Spear//b, /bFormation Break//b ends and /bBasic Attack: Converging Spear//b's stage is restored to the recorded stage.

/bFormation Break//b can trigger at most once against the same target before the target recovers from Stun. This skill is considered an /bUnbridled Spear//b attack

While in /bFormation Break//b the state, /bBasic Attack: Converging Spear//b does not trigger the /bChain Attack//b window when hitting Stunned enemies. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: Frozen Heavens (Ultimate)
ultimate.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [ULTIMATE] to activate:

Gathers the power of extreme cold before unleashing a devastating series of lunging attacks, dealing massive Ice DMG. This skill is considered an /bUnbridled Spear//b attack. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
